Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)
1. What is the codeshare flight number and series for EK Marketing on FZ?
EK 2000 - 2499 series
2. Will it be possible to continue to see EK and FZ mixed itineraries using the other FZ operated flights which are not included in the codeshare? 
Yes, other FZ operated flights not included in the codeshare can be booked as interline under FZ code and sold by EK for EK-FZ mixed itineraries.
3. What RBD do I book on each carrier on interline flights? 
When using a FZ flight number as an interline option, check fare rules and book customers on required RBDs as per the "View Booking Class" in fare display of the applicable fare rule.
4. Can customer be booked in higher cabin on EK and a lower cabin on FZ where FZ does not operate with higher cabin class?
Yes customer can be booked in combination of cabin class, check fare rules and book customers on required RBDs as per the "View Booking Class" in fare display of the applicable fare rule.
5. Can customers make changes to EK Marketing (FZ Operated) flights on emirates.com or via Emirates Contact Centre / Offices or via agent who booked and issued the ticket in GDS on EK (176) documents?
Yes, all Emirates codeshare fares support automated re-price via GDS / MARS / CaB therefore can be re-priced and must be re-issued via emirates.com, Emirates Contact Centre/ Offices or by agents who issued these tickets in GDS.
6. Can I sell a coach/bus service along with EK Marketing (FZ Operated) flights to/from DXB? 
Example 1: MCT – EK* - DXB – EK (Bus) – AAN
Example 2: AAN - EK (Bus) – DXB – EK* - KRR
Coach cannot be booked in conjunction with FZ flight.
7. Will Emirates (EK) and FlyDubai (FZ) operate from the same terminal when both airlines operate flights to the same airport?
Except DXB where FZ operates from Terminal 2 and 3, and KWI, both airlines operate from the same airport terminals at all other destinations. Routes operated by FZ from DWC are not going to be a part of the codeshare partnership.
8. Will e-ticket display terminal information of both EK and FZ? 
Terminal information will be available on e-ticket and flight schedules. 
Pricing and Ticketing
1. What combinations of EK and EK* Marketing (FZ Operated) fights are possible to sell?
Any Combinations of EK and EK* Marketing (FZ Operated) fights where fares are filed and auto priced can be booked.
2. Will customer connecting from EK operated flights to EK Marketing (FZ Operated) flight be able to take a stopover in Dubai?
Yes, provided it is allowed by the fare rules.
3. Should the ticket be re-issued or revalidated when making changes on itinerary involving flydubai?
Ticket will have to be reissued if a customer wants to change itineraries involving flydubai. Revalidation is not permitted.
4. Can EK reissue flydubai (141) documents during Involuntary changes? 
Refer to EK/FZ Planned schedule change and FZ Disruption policy.

Yes, EK baggage allowance applies on entire itinerary including EK Marketing (FZ Operated) flights (weight and pieces). Refer to flydubai website for baggage dimension rules.

Name Correction – Ticketing Procedure (Update) 
 
 
   
Greetings Trade Partners, 
Kindly find below the name correction procedures. 
IMPORTANT INFORMATION 
 
To avoid receiving ADM, please ensure to follow the below 2 steps. 
1. The Endorsement Remarks are added with required information while issuing EMD and Tickets. 
2. Send an email with all the information including the EMD details, Old ticket, and new ticket at 
KSASales@emirates.com. 
o The email subject should be for ; 
Jeddah:         JED - (NC EMD 176XXXXXXXXXX/OLD TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX/NEW TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX). 
Riyadh:         RUH - (NC EMD 176XXXXXXXXXX/OLD TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX/NEW TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX). 
Dammam:   DMM - (NC EMD 176XXXXXXXXXX/OLD TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX/NEW TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX). 
Madinah:     MED - (NC EMD 176XXXXXXXXXX/OLD TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX/NEW TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX). 
 
 Policy: 
 Name correction processes explained here is applicable only for EK documents (176xxxxxxxxxx) issued by IATA 
point of sales in KSA only. 
 The procedure is applicable for EK-Operated, Interline and Codeshare Flights. 
 Only one name correction is permitted per customer. 
 Up to 3 characters can be changed in the Family name. 
 In First and Middle names, more than 3 characters can be changed. 
 Surname/First name reversed: Some cultures (French speaking/China/Japan) often expect surname first and 
then family name in forms, in this case name can be reversed. 
 Name correction can be done at least 4 hours before the departure time. 
 Name correction fee is USD 30 (Via EMD). 
 Ticketing procedure: 
 If seats are available on the same RBDs: Create a new booking with the correct name. 
 If seats are not available on the same RBDs: Create a new booking on the available classes, then contact our call 
centre at 800 844 2000 / 8008500022 to confirm the booking for the same classes as per the original booking. 
 Issue name correction fee EMD with the amount of USD 30 by using EMD type Name Correction Fee I-02G, EMD 
must be issued on the original PNR. This RFISC type will be issued in Flown status (consumed on issuance). 
 Issue the new ticket with the same calculation as the old one, make sure to update the endorsement with “NC 
EMD 176XXXXXXXXXX/OLD TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX” 
 Cancel the old reservation and refund the old ticket without applying the refund fee, make sure to update the 
remark field with “NC EMD 176XXXXXXXXXX/NEW TKT 176XXXXXXXXXX”. 
Kindly disseminate this procedure to all concerned. 
 
Best regards, 
Emirates Airlines – KSA

It is agreed that Trip’s pre-war run-rate for both the listed incentives will be considered for the evaluation of the slab, but the payout will be on net-flown pax against the slab so determined. 
For example, Trip’s pre-war gross pax stood at ~5800 for the EU-origin incentive which would have met the top slab incentive of 45 USD in the event of no disruptions. Therefore, the 45 USD incentive shall be paid on the net-flown pax for this incentive scheme (~2100).

Pending marketing funds and future marketing plans
Trip has retired the marketing funds for previous financial years since the books have been closed in accordance with its audit guidelines. In Emirates’ tracking, there is still a net un-utilized marketing fund of ~290 K USD due to roll-overs of the fund from previous years.
